Metric.reasoning: This column names the specific property or trait being measured (e.g., BR, Temp).

Matrix value.reasoning: This column holds the primary measured value for the corresponding metric.

Simulated value.reasoning: This column holds a simulated or predicted value for comparison.

L 95 % CL.reasoning: This column provides the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval.

U 95 % CL.reasoning: This column provides the upper bound of the 95% confidence interval.

P (H0).reasoning: This column provides the p-value used for hypothesis testing (H0).
